# Luis Cabrera

> From product management to software engineering to agentic engineering. Building products with AI. Product-minded software engineer at P&G, based in Warsaw.

Started in Mexico in operations and product (FREENOW, Mercado Libre, Foxtrot Systems), then product manager at P&G on Pampers' global CRM and messaging ecosystem. Moved into mobile software engineering with Flutter and Dart in 2025. Today: agentic engineering, building and orchestrating teams of AI agents. MSc in Big Data & Advanced Analytics, SGH Warsaw School of Economics.

## Projects

- [Adoptsi](https://adoptsi.si): founded by Luis; brings AI agents and automation to traditional businesses.
- [FotoReady](https://foto-ready.luisecab93.workers.dev/landing): helps small sellers in Mexico transform a single product photo into marketplace-ready images.
- traX: personal health tracking and longevity insights (alpha).
